_readme: Media price rows, read on 2026-11-06 from each vendor's own pricing page. A row is an ESTIMATE shown before approval, never a quote: the vendor's account is authoritative. A route with no row Hutch could read is 'unpriced' and the approval says so. Bases: per_item (usd per image), per_audio_second (usd per second of audio; seconds are estimated from characters), per_video_second (usd per second requested), unpriced.

google-image.detail: gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, 1K image, Standard tier ($30 per 1M output image tokens)

google-speech.detail: gemini-3.8-flash-tts, Standard tier, 25 audio tokens per second at $9 per 1M; text input is under a thousandth of this

openai-image.detail: token billed: gpt-image-1-mini $8 per 1M image output tokens, gpt-image-1.5 $32, gpt-image-2 $30; tokens per image depend on size and quality and are not tabulated on the pricing page

openai-speech.detail: gpt-4o-mini-tts is $0.60 per 1M text input tokens and $12 per 1M audio output tokens; the audio tokens per second are not stated on the page read

xai-image.detail: xAI documents flat per-image pricing; the amount is on a pricing page not read

xai-video.detail: per second, varying with duration and resolution; the amount is on a pricing page not read

xai-speech.detail: the amount is on a pricing page not read

minimax-image.detail: the image page lists no price

minimax-speech.detail: billed on usage_characters; the page lists no per-character price

fal.detail: fal prices differ per model endpoint and are not tabulated here

pixverse.detail: credit billed by model, duration and quality; not tabulated here

elevenlabs-speech.detail: billed in characters against the plan; the page read lists no price

deepgram-speech.detail: per 1,000 characters; the page read states no price
